# Vũ Hoàng Phương (Phuong Vu Hoang)

> Design Manager and creative lead in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. 10+ years from graphic design to creative direction across brand identity, key visuals, events, photo and video, UI design and AI-assisted workflows. Portfolio: https://phuongvhapple.github.io/

Contact: phuongvh.apple@gmail.com · +84 986 362 186 · Ho Chi Minh City

## Professional summary

I'm a Design Manager who leads creative teams of up to 10 people. I run structured processes with measurable KPIs, clear resource allocation and efficient delivery in corporate, deadline-driven environments.

I stay hands-on. When timelines are tight or capacity runs short, I step into the work myself, clear the bottleneck and keep the team's performance sustainable.

I treat visual storytelling as a business tool: turning briefs into well-structured visuals that follow brand strategy across digital, graphic and integrated touchpoints.

I also design UI for apps and websites in Figma, building layouts, components and screens that carry the brand into digital products.

AI is part of my daily design workflow, from image generation and video editing to automating graphics-related tasks. I regularly use Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini alongside one another, choosing the right tool for each task. I’m comfortable learning new AI tools and would welcome the opportunity to explore them further with the company’s support.

At a glance: Experience 10+ years Graphic design to creative direction Team size Up to 10 Design, photo, video, events, digital Senior Design Officer at Dai-ichi Life Vietnam. Previously Sunrise Events Vietnam, CEN Group, Banyan Tree Group, Nam Long and Thien Minh Group.

## About

Open, driven and energetic, with a confident approach. Logical thinking, strong organisation and disciplined time management keep complex projects moving.

Trusted to work with minimal supervision. I guide teams toward their goals across graphic design, creative direction, video and photography production, events and digital.

Curious and quick to adopt new tools. I see AI as part of a modern creative workflow, use it with good judgement and keep brand quality and the final call with the designer.

Skills: Creative direction, Brand identity, Key visual concepts, UI design, Event design, Photo & video direction, AI-assisted workflows, Team leadership, Presenting & training, Negotiation.
